pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Dragon Variation, Classical Variation
pages.notes: Plan 2 had ...Rc8 with the bishop still on c8 and ...Rxc3 with no rook on the c-file. Reworded plan 2; British spelling in the overview and plan 1.

pages.name: Sicilian: Dragon, 6.Bc4
pages.notes: Plan 2 had ...Rc8 with the bishop still on c8. Reworded plan 2.

pages.name: Sicilian: Dragon, 6.Bc4 Bg7
pages.notes: Plan 1 had a Qe1-h4 route through the f2-pawn; plan 2 called a pawn advance a minority attack. Rewrote plans 1 and 2; British spelling in plan 3.

pages.name: Sicilian: Dragon, 6.Bc4 Bg7 7.h3
pages.notes: Plan 1 had White castle short and play f3 in a way that is not a standard setup; plan 2 had ...Rxc3 with no rook on the c-file. Rewrote plan 1 around Be3, Bb3 and the choice of f4 or a Yugoslav-style f3, Qd2 and O-O-O; reworded plan 2.

pages.name: Sicilian: Dragon, 6.Bc4 Bg7 7.O-O
pages.notes: Plan 2 had ...Rxc3 with no rook on the c-file; plan 1 had h3 preparing g4 in a castled position. Rewrote plan 1 (reviewer caught that Bb3 does not escape a knight on a5) and reworded plan 2.

pages.name: Sicilian: Dragon, 6.Be2 a6
pages.notes: Plan 3 had ...Rxc3 with no rook on the c-file. Reworded plan 3; British spelling in plan 4.

pages.name: Sicilian: Dragon, 6.Be2 Bg7
pages.notes: Plan 1 said f3 blunts the g7-bishop (it is on the dark a1-h8 diagonal); plan 4 had ...Rxc3 with no rook on the c-file. Rewrote plans 1 and 4. Plan 3 (a vague plan aiming for a favourable endgame) was rewritten twice and rejected twice, the second time because Kh1 needs castling first; the old text is kept with British spelling.

pages.name: Sicilian: Dragon, 6.Be2 Bg7 7.O-O
pages.notes: Plan 1 had an f2-f4-f5 route and Bh6 without Be3 and Qd2; plan 2 had ...Rc8 with the bishop still on c8. Rewrote plans 1 and 2.

pages.name: Sicilian: Dragon, 6.Be2 Bg7 7.O-O Nc6
pages.notes: Plan 1 had an Nb3-d5 route and Bh6 in the Classical setup. Rewrote plan 1 around Nb3, Be3, f4 and Kh1.

pages.name: Sicilian: Dragon, 6.Be2 Bg7 7.O-O Nc6 8.Nb3
pages.notes: Plan 2 had ...Rxc3 and ...Rc8 with the bishop still on c8; plan 1 proposed f3 in the Classical; plan 3 routed the knight to the occupied c1. Rewrote plans 1-3.
